sentences.en: You are too clever not to solve the hard problem.
sentences.zh: 你太聪明了，不可能解决不了这个难题。

sentences.en: He may be clever, but he is not very helpful.
sentences.zh: 他可能很聪明，但并不怎么有帮助。

sentences.en: He may be clever, but he often makes careless mistakes.
sentences.zh: 他虽然聪明，但经常犯粗心的错误。

senses.zh: [ 比较级cleverer 最高级 cleverest ]
